description: Implementation of AWCContainer class managing application containers, including start, stop, and state change notifications within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: Manages application container lifecycle, state, and communication with AWCClient.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID if the container is started, otherwise 0.

methods.name: AWCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: AWCContainer::WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Waits until the AWC service is ready, with a maximum of 30 seconds.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for confirmation or timeout.

methods.name: AWCContainer::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from AWCClient.
